name: Angelic cuts Illumination's cast time by 0.25/0.5 sec per rank (#1213)
contract: Angelic has two rank spell IDs, both SpellFamilyName 33, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 bit 0x200 (512): rank 1 (704582) is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) and EffectBasePoints -251 -> real -250 ms; rank 2 (707771) is the same aura/op with EffectBasePoints -501 -> real -500 ms. Illumination's base spell (500143, Rank 1) carries SpellFamilyFlags_2 512 -- the same bit -- so SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod admits it on the shared family and mask. SpellInfo::CalcCastTime consumes SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME through Player::ApplySpellMod inside its own calculation, which the 'spell_cast_time_ms' query metric reads directly. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level with no ratings, so their cast-speed multipliers are identical and only the flat modifier can move the difference. Native handlers only; regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Illumination's cast time without either rank
Rank 1 cuts Illumination's cast time by 0.25 sec
Rank 2 cuts Illumination's cast time by 0.5 sec
